name: La Pola de Gordón (Spain)
description: Square flag quartered blue and white by a white cross, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of La Pola de Gordón (a tower and a lion, with the motto MÁS PESO A NON LO PRISO).
history: Municipal flag of La Pola de Gordón; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: La Pola de Gordón arms — tower and lion, inscribed GORDÓN with motto
cap of the crown of the arms
